reason: The kernel correctly handles masking, sign (via x<0), fp16→fp32 conversion, and storage offsets. The degree-15 odd minimax polynomial on [0,1.05] is far more accurate than the 1e-6 tolerance requires (the branch point at ±i lies well outside the relevant Bernstein ellipse once the interval extends past 1), and the log(x+sqrt(1+x²)) branch accumulates only ~1 fp32 ulp of error even at the largest fp16 magnitude, which is borderline but generally within the fixed 1e-6 absolute tolerance.
